name: Harvard Standard Semester Pattern
description: Standard US semester pattern — 4-credit courses (one semester each). Letter grades A-F on 4.0 GPA scale. Fall semester (Sep-Dec), Spring semester (Jan-May). Reading period before final exams each term.

in_semester.name: Midterm / Continuous Assessment
in_semester.notes: Harvard courses have varied assessment — typically problem sets (20-30%), midterm (20-30%), final exam (40-50%), plus participation/projects. No fixed marks split.

instructions: Answer all questions. The final examination covers the full semester's material.
Show all work for full credit.
This is a closed-book examination unless otherwise specified.

question_structure.description: Comprehensive final examination. Format varies by course — may include problem-solving, essays, proofs, multiple choice. Typically 3-hour exam during exam period after reading week.
